```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(agriAnomalyR)
```

## Chargement des données

```{r}
path <- system.file("extdata", "agriculture_dataset_with_target.csv", package = "agriAnomalyR")
raw <- import_sensor_data(path)
head(raw)
```

## Nettoyage

```{r}
clean <- clean_sensor_data(raw)
```

## Détection d'anomalies

```{r}
anom <- detect_anomalies(clean, method = "moving_average")
anom <- classify_anomalies(anom)
table(anom$anomaly_type, useNA = "ifany")
```

## Imputation

```{r}
imputed <- impute_missing_values(anom, method = "linear")
```

## Statistiques et alertes

```{r}
calculate_sensor_statistics(imputed)
generate_alerts(imputed)
```

## Visualisation

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=8}
plot_timeseries(imputed)
```
